narrative.details: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hm, you took this from the corpse of one of the invading abominations?We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they wanted to create one inside Stormwind. It is good that they were unseccessful.
